schema.name: reusable-verification-platform-program-sprint-index
schema.description: Stable program sprint index. P01–P37 are new identifiers. Historical Sprint12/M4, Sprint13/M5, Sprint14/M6 remain legacy labels only. dependencies are hard predecessors. conditional_dependencies are actual consumed-API conditions. resource_gate is spending policy, not a semantic edge, and is satisfied only by the named platform_reuse_predicate when present. successful_exit, partial_delivery, and terminal_disposition are distinct. This file is a planning index, not acceptance or a calendar. Candidate SHA-256 values are copied from CURRENT.json lane candidate.sha256 and must be compared to that file, not self-asserted. Revision planning-repair-r2-20260908 is a bounded PR1–PR3 planning repair pending independent GPT-6 review; it does not set a review gate accepted.

fields.title: Human-readable title. Required.
fields.dependencies: Array of Pnn ids that are true hard predecessors. Empty array if none. Resource gates are not listed here.
fields.resource_gate: Optional Pnn id whose named platform_reuse_predicate must hold before implementation spend. Null if none. Arithmetic-only reuse does not satisfy this field.
fields.reuse_claim_requires: Optional array of Pnn ids required before a two-case reuse claim may be published.
fields.legacy_mapping: Original Sprint/M labels, OpenSpec change ids, CURRENT.json lane ids, and original task-id ranges. Original ids stay discoverable and are not relabelled delivered.
fields.change: Owning OpenSpec change for this program row. Always reusable-verification-platform-program for new program work; original packages remain linked from legacy_mapping.
fields.path: Object of existing and proposed paths. Keys ending in _proposed are not accepted APIs.
fields.entry: Entry gate that must hold before implementation of this sprint.
fields.claim_boundary: What a successful sprint may claim, and what it must not claim.
fields.roadmap_ids: R01–R47 coverage contributed by this sprint. Empty if the work is a CURRENT.json remainder not given its own unchecked R-id.
fields.successful_exit: Required outcomes independently accepted and delivered. Blocked or rejected status is recorded in terminal_disposition and standing task 1.8; it is not this field.
fields.partial_delivery: Optional coherent accepted subset that leaves the sprint remainder open.
fields.terminal_disposition: How a failed/blocked/rejected attempt is recorded. Never a successful_exit substitute.
fields.evidence_class: One of proof_review, implementation_proof, data_repair, record_integrity, mixed_behavior. Determines applicable standing gates.
fields.conditional_dependencies: Named consumed APIs/evidence that apply only when that branch is claimed.
fields.hash_bindings: CURRENT.json lane id to sha256 copied from that file.
fields.evaluated_api_closure: For freeze/eval sprints, the declared evaluated API/library sprints.
fields.platform_reuse_predicate: Optional named predicate, currently P17.platform_reuse. Distinct from arithmetic_reuse. Required for resource-gated family spend.
fields.arithmetic_reuse: Optional. Narrow arithmetic or interface/library reuse that MAY be published without opening the platform resource gate.

schema.hard_versus_recommended: dependencies are the DAG. recommended_order is a spending sequence. resource_gate is policy. conditional_dependencies are real when that branch is used. P18 depends only on P16. P37 successful_exit joins every required lane terminal.

User authorization to execute after independent GPT-6 acceptance of this revision is recorded separately; do not re-ask. Frozen r1 archive and historical reviews are not rewritten. This revision is not original liquidity 1.2 acceptance.
